assay_targets_or_enrichments.ontology_label: Chemical cross-linking coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

acquisition: MS1 spectra were collected using the Orbitrap at resolution 100,000 with preview mode enabled.
The raw MS data were processed into peak lists using Mascot server.
enrichment: chemical crosslinking coupled with tandem mass spectrometry (XL-MS)
A homo-bifunctional crosslinker, bis-(sulfosuccinimidyl)suberate (BS3, Thermo Fisher Scientific), was used
we chose a water-soluble hetero-bifunctional chemical crosslinker, sulfo-SMCC
workflow_hints: Chemical cross-linking coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics
The StavroX 3.5.1 software was used to generate a list of the crosslinked peptides.

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic XL-MS (Cross-linking Mass Spectrometry) study to determine protein complex architecture. While not a standard 'enrichment' in the PTM sense, it targets the complexome/structural interactions. Acquisition is DDA based on the use of an LTQ Orbitrap and Mascot/StavroX processing of fragmentation spectra.

scope: the complex was isolated by immobilized metal affinity chromatography (IMAC)
the released His6-SUMO was removed by size exclusion chromatography (SEC) on Superdex S200, yielding the (NIA)2 complex
(NIAU)2 complex was prepared by mixing (NIA)2 and ISCU, and the complex was isolated by SEC
(NIAUF)2 complex was prepared by mixing (NIAU)2 and FXN, and the complex was isolated by SEC
Bands from the SDS–PAGE gels corresponding to crosslinked complexes were excised, and the proteins were reduced/alkylated and digested

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The analyzed material consists of purified protein complexes ((NIA)2, (NIAU)2, (NIAUF)2) isolated via IMAC and SEC. The complexes are mixed-species as they contain human proteins (NFS1, ISD11, ISCU, FXN) and E. coli Acp.
